Two intervals `[a_start, a_end)` and `[b_start, b_end)` overlap if `max(a_start, b_start) < min(a_end, b_end)`.

Because it's a half-open interval `[x, y)`, it is non-empty if and only if `x < y`.

`return max(a[0], b[0]) <= min(a[1], b[1])`
This uses `<=` instead of `<`.
If `max(starts) == min(ends)`, then the intersection is `[x, x)`, which is empty.

So the candidate code incorrectly returns True for touching intervals.
